INTERNATIONAL STANDARD ISO 14644-1: Cleanrooms and associated controlled environments
Classification of air cleanliness by particle concentration for ISO Class 5 and Class 7
Maximum cumulative particle count for ISO Class 5: 3,520 particles per cubic meter >= 0.5 um
Maximum cumulative particle count for ISO Class 7: 352,000 particles per cubic meter >= 0.5 um
Laminar airflow requirement: unidirectional airflow velocity 0.35 to 0.45 m/s across work envelope
Differential pressure cascading: minimum +15 Pa between cleanroom pod and surrounding gowning zone
HEPA filtration: minimum 99.99% particulate capture efficiency at 0.3 micron MPPS

AEROSPACE MATERIAL SPECIFICATION AMS 5662
NICKEL ALLOY, CORROSION AND HEAT RESISTANT, BARS, FORGINGS, AND RINGS
52.5Ni - 19Cr - 3.0Mo - 5.1Cb (Nb) - 0.90Ti - 0.50Al - 18Fe
Consumable Electrode Melted, Solution Heat Treated, Precipitation Hardenable (Inconel 718)

1. APPLICATION:
Primarily for parts requiring high resistance to creep and stress-rupture up to 704°C (1300°F) and oxidation resistance up to 982°C (1800°F).
Used for rocket thrust chambers, cryogenic injector coaxial sleeves, and turbine rotor hubs.

2. TENSILE AND YIELD LIMITS (Aged Condition):
- Tensile Ultimate Strength: 1,240 MPa (180 ksi).
- 0.2% Offset Yield Strength: 1,034 MPa (150 ksi).
- Elongation in 4D: 12% minimum.
- Reduction of Area: 15% minimum.
- Hardness: 36 to 44 HRC.
- Density: 8.19 g/cm^3.
- Young's Modulus: 200 GPa at 20°C, 172 GPa at 650°C.

3. FABRICATION & ADDITIVE RULES:
- Direct Metal Laser Sintering (DMLS) requires stress-relief vacuum anneal at 1065°C for 1 hour followed by two-stage precipitation aging (720°C / 8h + 620°C / 8h).
- Machining requires rigid tooling with positive rake geometry and high-pressure flood coolant to mitigate severe work hardening.
- Minimum allowable wall thickness for additively manufactured thin-wall injector channels: 0.80 mm.

# MIL-HDBK-5J DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE HANDBOOK
## METALLIC MATERIALS AND ELEMENTS FOR AEROSPACE VEHICLE STRUCTURES
### Section 5.4 — Titanium and Titanium Alloys (Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5 ELI)

1. Scope and Composition:
Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400 / AMS 4928) annealed bar and forgings. Extra Low Interstitial (ELI) grade for cryogenic and fracture-critical flight components.
Nominal chemical composition: Aluminum 5.50-6.75%, Vanadium 3.50-4.50%, Iron max 0.40%, Oxygen max 0.20%, Titanium remainder.

2. Design Allowable Mechanical Properties (Room Temperature):
- Minimum Tensile Ultimate Strength (F_tu): 896 MPa (130 ksi) A-basis, 950 MPa (138 ksi) B-basis.
- Minimum Tensile Yield Strength (F_ty): 827 MPa (120 ksi) at 0.2% offset.
- Compressive Yield Strength (F_cy): 869 MPa (126 ksi).
- Shear Ultimate Strength (F_su): 552 MPa (80 ksi).
- Bearing Yield Strength (F_bry): 1,379 MPa (e/D = 1.5) / 1,724 MPa (e/D = 2.0).
- Modulus of Elasticity (E): 113.8 GPa (16.5 x 10^6 psi).
- Poisson's Ratio (ν): 0.342.
- Density (ρ): 4.43 g/cm^3 (0.160 lb/in^3).

3. Thermal Operating Envelope:
- Maximum sustained continuous operating temperature: 425°C (800°F).
- Cryogenic limit: Operational down to -253°C (20 K liquid hydrogen immersion) with verified Charpy V-notch energy >= 20 J.
- Coefficient of Thermal Expansion (CTE): 8.6 x 10^-6 /°C (20°C to 100°C).

4. Fracture Mechanics and Mandatory Fatigue Design Rules:
- Plane Strain Fracture Toughness (K_Ic): 75 MPa·m^0.5 for ELI condition.
- Minimum safety factor: 1.50x on limit loads, 2.00x on ultimate loads for pressurized manifolds and primary structural brackets.
- Sharp internal fillets under R = 1.5mm strictly prohibited; minimum radius R >= 2.5mm required to prevent notch sensitivity fatigue propagation.

standards.title: Metallic Materials and Elements for Aerospace Vehicle Structures: Titanium Alloy Tensile & Fatigue Limits
standards.governing_rules: Minimum tensile yield strength F_ty = 825 MPa at room temperature; elongation in 2 inches must exceed 10%. Cyclic thermal boundary limit <= 420°C for continuous operation. Minimum wall thickness for structural brackets subject to vibratory flutter: 3.0 mm.

standards.title: Controlled Environments — Air Purity and Classification Standards
standards.clause_reference: Table 1 — Selected airborne particulate purity classes
standards.governing_rules: Controlled environment class 5 requires <= 3,520 particles/m³ for particles >= 0.5 µm and <= 29 particles/m³ for particles >= 5.0 µm. Mandatory positive differential pressure of +30 Pa between chamber and surrounding enclosure. HEPA filter integrity test required every 6 months.

standards.title: Standard Specification for Additive Manufacturing Titanium-6 Aluminum-4 Vanadium with Powder Bed Fusion
standards.clause_reference: Section 8 — Chemical and Mechanical Requirements for DMLS/PBF
standards.governing_rules: Components produced by Laser Powder Bed Fusion (DMLS) must undergo Stress Relief Heat Treatment at 700°C for 1 hour under vacuum or argon shield. Minimum tensile strength F_tu = 895 MPa, yield F_ty = 825 MPa. Internal channels under ⌀4.0mm must be inspected by Optical CMM or Computed Tomography.

standards.title: Alternative Rules for Pressure Vessels and Pressurized Fluid Manifolds
standards.governing_rules: Allowable stress intensity for manifold blocks shall not exceed two-thirds of yield strength (2/3 * S_y) at design operating temperature. Full hydrostatic proof pressure test at 1.43x Maximum Allowable Working Pressure (MAWP) required before operational sign-off.
